about_the_game:
GORE is a found footage horror experience that immerses players in a mountain range designed to resemble the scenery of the Pacific Northwest of the United States. Drawing inspiration from the likes of Lovecraft, 2001: A Space Odyssey, and John Carpenter’s The Thing, this game pulls you deep into a decaying wilderness where something incomprehensible is rapidly spreading through the surrounding environment. You must discover where this fleshy entity came from, armed with only a flashlight and handheld camera. 

This game is an environmental and psychological horror that will have the player on the edge of their seats. You can expect lots of twists and turns and maybe a couple of jump scares! You will also find a lore-rich and linear story with reliance on high tension and fear of the unknown. The game's story is told through the players' inner dialogue and through notes scattered around each level. Triggering dialogue events and notes via exploration will unlock new areas, allowing the player to progress through the game.

This game includes:

> Handheld/ VHS-like post-processing and realistic movements, creating a nostalgic, yet uncanny experience

> Two fully fleshed out (pun intended) levels, including mountains, caves, labs, and...?

> An original soundtrack composed by myself

> A LOT of fleshy entities, huge eyeballs, and mutated remains

> Completely custom mountain Ranges and landscapes

> Toggleable flashlight for dark areas

> One primary ending, one easter egg ending

> One insane twist that you don't want to miss out on!

content_descriptors.notes: "GORE" contains an alien, fleshy bio-mass that squelches and sometimes hisses - it is scattered all throughout the game. The bio-mass closely resembled dismembered remains and may be disturbing at times.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel Core i5-7400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 570 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirextX-Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600 / Intel Core i5-10400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 7600 / NVIDIA RTX 2060 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirextX-Compatible

short_description: A found footage horror experience set deep in the mountains of the Pacific Northwest with Lovecraftian inspiration. Explore the wilderness and uncover where this cosmic entity came from.
